heart.subject: S-20-28
heart.description: Human heart, male 84, post mortem; formalin, ethanol and agar preparation
heart.coordinate_system: local acquisition axes; anatomical orientation not assigned
heart.processing: N5 Blosc decoded big endian uint16; context s4 sampled every second voxel without averaging; detail is complete s0 block 37/18/31. Padded edge voxels cropped to declared dimensions. Intensity retained uint16; window affects display only.
heart.limits: Voxel spacing is sampling, not guaranteed resolving power. Fixed tissue, no activity. Published within-donor alignment between overview and sinus-region acquisition reused as-is, numerical convention verified, independent anatomical error not supplied. No registration to other people.

sinus_region.region_label: sinoatrial node according to source acquisition title; no voxel-level cell identity or segmentation supplied

heart.sampling_centers: N5 voxel coordinates use cell boundaries: native voxel center index+0.5; s4 center in native coordinates 16*(index+0.5). Every-second s4 sample has native center 32*displayIndex+8, not +16. Display planes preserve these centers; nearest rendering footprints do not imply new measurements.

vagus.subject: sub-f002, female 88, human ex vivo, left nerve
vagus.license: Creative Commons Attribution (exact wording in dataset metadata; version not specified there)
vagus.geometry: Finite element scaffold fitted to stitched segmentation; named surfaces from portal visualization export. Perineurial contour segments are exported stitched segmentation, separate from fitted envelope. Source float coordinates preserved in JSON, contour buffer uses float32 as original exported precision.
vagus.units: µm, import and stitching scale traced through the original C10 segment; mesh lengths are model-derived, not in-body measurements.
vagus.limits: Non-body configuration: cut segments stitched computationally. Branches show origins and initial directions; no complete organ innervation, electrical propagation or proven cardiac linkage.
vagus.display_transform: Uniform centering and scale for display, followed by rigid axis rotation (x,y,z) -> (x,z,-y). Original source axes retained in data. No anatomical registration.
vagus.line_decoding: ZincJS LineSegments uses sequential vertex pairs; compatibility triangle faces are sequential and padded with the final vertex, not interpreted as contour triangles. Final zero-length padding omitted.

nerve_ct.subject: sub-f002, female 88
nerve_ct.processing: Display axis permutation U=NIfTI axis1,V=axis0,Z=axis2; context sampled every 4th voxel; detail all voxels Z 64..191 inclusive, original uint8 intensities unchanged. Source contour curves displayed only on planes actually annotated, no interpolation.
nerve_ct.limits: Nominal spacing from protocol and XML, header units unknown. Image-to-XML correspondence checked visually; no independent registration uncertainty. No electrical activity or fiber identities inferred.
nerve_ct.sampling_centers: Image positions for MBF correspondence use pixel indices U,V and slice index Z multiplied by 9, as in the original annotation convention. No subvoxel alignment precision is asserted.
